user.title: Energy Tariff Helper
user.description: Name this meter. You'll set its tariff windows next.

init.title: Tariff options
init.description: The daily supply charge is billed per day regardless of usage. Windows are recurring daily periods; a window whose end is earlier than its start spans midnight. On overlap, the earliest-listed window wins.

data_description.windows: A JSON list, e.g. [{"start": "07:00", "end": "23:00", "import_rate": 0.35, "export_rate": 0.05}]. Times are 24-hour; rates are per kWh.

error.windows_not_a_list: The windows must be a JSON list.
error.window_not_an_object: Each window must be a JSON object.
error.window_missing_field: Each window needs start, end, import_rate and export_rate.
error.window_time_not_string: Start and end times must be strings like "07:00".
error.window_time_out_of_range: Times must be a valid 24-hour clock time.
error.zero_length_window: A window's start and end times must differ.
error.window_rate_not_number: Import and export rates must be numbers.
error.window_rate_negative: Import and export rates cannot be negative.
